build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs && cd web/frontend && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'pip install -r requirements.txt && python bot.py & python middleware_listener.py & python -m uvicorn web.backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --log-level info & wait'
